analysis.reason: 일봉 RSI 36.0으로 과매도 구간 진입, 5일 연속 하락 후 반등 시도. 그러나 SMA20($52.08) 대비 -30% 이상 하회, 주봉 RSI 36.2로 여전히 약세 구간. MACD 히스토그램 개선세 미약하여 추세 전환 확신 부족. 3배 레버리지 상품 특성상 변동성 극심하여 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Daily RSI at 36.0 entering oversold territory, attempting rebound after 5 consecutive down days. However, still trading over 30% below SMA20 ($52.08) and weekly RSI at 36.2 remains in weak zone. MACD histogram shows minimal improvement, lacking conviction for trend reversal. Extreme volatility inherent in 3x leveraged product necessitates caution.

analysis.narrativeEn:

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Current Phase Diagnosis: Rebound attempt within a downtrend, extreme volatility warrants a wait-and-see approach
